messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <security@finbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request: CVE traceability ledger + compensating controls

Hi Irene,

We're preparing for a SIG questionnaire and need targeted vulnerability-management evidence for our internal audit. Can you provide the following by EOD Thursday (2027-06-24)?

1) A traceability ledger that maps scanner finding IDs (internal hashes) to CVE identifiers and the remediation owner for each entry (CSV or Excel preferred).
2) A raw authenticated scan snapshot (current state) that shows the finding timestamps and scanner version, for the June 20 scan.
3) A short attestation describing compensating controls in place for CVE-2027-12345 (legacy container image) if the fix is not yet deployed.
4) Confirmation of scan cadence (frequency, authenticated vs unauthenticated) and retention policy for raw scan artifacts.

Background: CVE-2027-12345 is referenced in our SIG intake and relates to an old third-party image used only in a limited internal job runner cluster. We need the linkage and a plan for remediation or compensating controls for the SIG submission.

Please include any DocuSign/attestation templates you prefer — our compliance team needs a signed statement to close their control.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Security Program Manager
FinBridge
[Attachment: SIG-request-form.pdf (PDF, 24KB)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the requested artifacts and an attestation for SIG. High-level plan and next steps below; I’ll drop the ledger and snapshot to the Drive link and attach a short compensating-controls summary for immediate review.

Mutual action plan (deliverables / owners / ETA):
- VM traceability ledger (VM-traceability-ledger.xlsx) — owner: Monica Patel — ETA: 2027-06-23 15:00 PDT (Drive + attached)
- Raw scan snapshot (scan-snapshot-20270620.jsonl) — owner: Monica Patel — ETA: 2027-06-23 15:00 PDT
- Compensating controls summary (compensating-controls-summary.pdf) — owner: Kimberly Park — ETA: 2027-06-23 12:00 PDT
- Signed attestation template (if you provide one we will sign; otherwise we can produce a Redwood attestation statement) — owner: Irene Choi — ETA: 2027-06-24

Immediate notes:
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated scans of production and staging; unauthenticated daily light scans for edge environments. We retain raw authenticated scan artifacts for 180 days by default; summaries (aggregated ledgers) are kept for 2 years.
- CVE-2027-12345: we have it isolated to an internal job-runner fleet (non-customer-facing). Kimberly will propose compensating controls (network egress policy + runtime policy exception) while we schedule remediation.

Attachments included: VM-traceability-ledger.xlsx (index), compensating-controls-summary.pdf (draft). Raw scan snapshot is large; link will be provided on Drive.

If that timeline works I’ll mark the repo as delivered and send the attestation draft for signature.

Best,
Irene Choi

Subject: Re: SIG evidence request: CVE traceability ledger + compensating controls

Irene / Elena — quick technical addendum on CVE-2027-12345: 

- Root cause: vulnerable component in legacy container base image (openssl 1.0.x build).
- Scope: present on 6 hosts in the internal job-runner pool (non-prod tags present but accepted risk due to data isolation).
- Immediate compensating controls we’ve applied (effective 2027-06-21):
  * Network policy: egress to internet blocked for job-runner namespace except approved IPs.
  * Runtime enforcement: seccomp profiles + read-only rootfs for new pods.
  * WAF rule: application-layer filtering on the exposed management endpoints.
- Remediation plan: backport/replace vulnerable image and cut new image within a 45-day remediation window; hotpatch option available for 30-day earliest if the vendor patch is backported successfully.
- Test window: staged rollout and smoke tests scheduled 48h after image publish; rollback plan documented in Runbook RB-31 (internal).

I’ll attach the short runbook extract and a note about test telemetry we will provide after the rollout.

Kimberly Park
Director, Vulnerability Management
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook-RB-31-extract.pdf (PDF, 9KB)]

Team —

Got everything, thank you. Quick confirmations:
- FinBridge accepts the compensating controls list as interim evidence for SIG submission, pending final remediation traceability.
- Please upload the raw scan snapshot to the shared Drive link and send the final attestation text by end of day Friday (2027-06-25). We will need the attestation signed (DocuSign or similar).

Two minor asks:
1) In the attestation please explicitly state scan cadence (weekly authenticated) and retention (180 days).
2) Add a single-line statement that CVE-2027-12345 is contained to internal job-runner cluster and is not present on customer workloads.

If you can provide the short signed attestation by Friday we can close the SIG control and update the SIG portal. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
